title: Where to Buy Real Hand Block Print Kurta Sets Online in the USA, UK & Canada (2026 Guide)
excerpt: How to spot real hand block print, what a fair price is, size conversion for US/UK, and how to avoid customs charges when buying a kurta set from India.
body:
Searching for a real hand block print kurta set from outside India can be confusing. Many listings say "block print" but are machine or screen printed, sizes are unclear, and surprise customs charges arrive at the door. This guide shows you exactly what to check – so you get the real thing at a fair price.

## Quick answer

Buy direct from a Jaipur maker who (1) shows close-up photos of the print, (2) lists the fabric of every piece, (3) offers custom sizing, and (4) ships **duties-paid (DDP)** so the price you see is the price you pay. Expect to pay **$45–$60** for a 3-piece cotton hand block print set with a kota doria dupatta.

## 5 checks before you buy

| Check | What to look for | Red flag |
|---|---|---|
| 1. The print | Tiny shifts, slightly uneven edges, small gaps where blocks meet | Perfectly identical, razor-sharp repeats |
| 2. The back of the fabric | Colour soaks through to the reverse | Print only on the surface |
| 3. Fabric of each piece | Kurta, pants and dupatta fabric named separately (e.g. cotton + kota doria) | Only "cotton blend" or no fabric listed |
| 4. Sizing | XS–3XL plus made-to-measure | One "free size" |
| 5. Shipping | Duties and taxes included (DDP), delivery time stated | "Customs charges are the buyer's responsibility" |

Want the full method? Read [Hand Block Print vs Screen Print: How to Tell the Difference](/blog/hand-block-print-vs-screen-print-how-to-tell-the-difference/).

## What a fair price looks like

| Set type | Typical price (USD) |
|---|---|
| Cotton kurta + pants, hand block print | $35–$48 |
| Cotton kurta + pants + kota doria dupatta | $45–$60 |
| Kota doria kurta set (lined) | $50–$70 |
| Embroidered or gota festive set | $55–$90 |

Much cheaper than this usually means screen printing or synthetic fabric. Much more expensive usually means boutique mark-up – not better craft.

## Why kota doria dupattas are worth it

Kota doria is a featherlight handloom fabric from Rajasthan with a checked (khat) weave. It drapes softly, stays cool and does not feel heavy like a cotton dupatta. Read our [Kota Doria Fabric Guide](/blog/kota-doria-fabric-guide/).

## Frequently asked questions

**How can I tell if a kurta set is real hand block print?**
Look for tiny irregularities in the repeat, slight overlaps where blocks meet, and colour that shows through on the back of the fabric. Screen prints look perfectly uniform.

**How much does a real hand block print kurta set cost in the USA?**
A 3-piece cotton set with a kota doria dupatta usually costs $45–$60 when bought direct from Jaipur.

**Will I pay customs on an Indian kurta set?**
Not with Bahe Kurtiz – shipping to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia is duties-paid (DDP), so there is nothing extra to pay on delivery.

**Does hand block print fade?**
Natural colour can soften slightly over time. Wash cold, inside-out, and dry in shade – see our [care guide](/blog/how-to-wash-and-care-for-block-printed-cotton-kurtis/).

**Can I get a kurta set stitched to my size?**
Yes. Choose Custom Fit on the product page and share your bust, waist and hip – it is free.
